explore.noMatchHint: Try another word, like a place or a name.

notFound.title: Page not found

viewer.zoomHint: Double-tap to zoom · drag to move

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the e-mail you signed up with and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If this e-mail has an account, we've sent a password reset link. The link works once and expires in {{minutes}} minutes.
forgot.checkSpam: Don't see it? Check the Spam folder.
forgot.failed: Couldn't send the request right now. Please try again.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.doneBody: You can sign in with your new password. Devices already signed in keep working until their session ends.
reset.missingToken: This link has no confirmation code. Open the exact link from the e-mail, or request a new one.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.failed: Couldn't change the password. The link may have expired.
reset.singleUse: The link works only once — do not share it.

invite.title: Invite family
invite.subtitle: Send an invitation to the family album — administrators only.
invite.expiryHint: Each invitation works once and expires after a few days.

invite.copyFailed: Could not copy — please select and copy manually.
invite.loadFailed: Could not load the invitation list.
